title: SimplyScan
description: Security, SEO and AI-visibility scanner for web apps · free scans and focused checks via MCP.
summary: Security, SEO and AI-visibility scanner for web apps · free scans and focused checks via MCP.
offersHint: Security, SEO and AI-visibility scanner for web apps · free scans and focused checks via MCP. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.simplyscan.io/mcp

toolsPreview.name: scan_website
toolsPreview.description: Run a free SimplyScan security & speed scan of a deployed web app URL. Returns a 0-100 score and findings (exposed secrets, missing Supabase RLS, frontend leaks, speed issues). Best for apps built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, Replit, etc.

toolsPreview.name: check_security_headers
toolsPreview.description: Grade a URL's HTTP security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP, COEP) A-F.

toolsPreview.name: check_ai_visibility
toolsPreview.description: AEO check: whether AI answer engines (ChatGPT/GPTBot, Claude, Perplexity, Google-Extended, etc.) can crawl and cite the site, plus llms.txt and structured-data signals.

toolsPreview.name: check_seo
toolsPreview.description: On-page SEO audit of a URL: title, meta description, H1, canonical, indexability, Open Graph, structured data, image alt coverage, sitemap. Returns an A-F grade.

toolsPreview.name: check_ssl
toolsPreview.description: Inspect a domain's SSL/TLS certificate: issuer, expiry, protocol, and flags for expiring/self-signed/mismatched certs.

toolsPreview.name: check_email_security
toolsPreview.description: Check a domain's email authentication: SPF, DKIM (common selectors), and DMARC policy. Flags spoofable domains.

toolsPreview.name: check_exposed_files
toolsPreview.description: Probe a site for accidentally exposed high-risk files (.env, .git/config, backups, etc.). Reports HTTP status only, never file contents.
